content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GMCH Chandigarh Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.gmch.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GMCH Chandigarh Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the GMCH Chandigarh Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) recruitment is 24th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First class Post Graduate degree including integrated PG degree (Life sciences or any biology stream) OR a Second class Post Graduate degree including integrated PG degree, with PhD (Life sciences or any biology stream).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per ICMR rules for specific categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 67200 Per Month, which includes Rs 56000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by sending the duly filled application form along with required documents to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by a screening examination if required, and an interaction with shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of GMCH Chandigarh, www.gmch.gov.in. Links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is G.M.C.H-Med-2026/395.

faq.answer: Yes, the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) position is a contractual job.
